notes.md: - **Indian Science Congress:** **108th session** at **RTM Nagpur University, Nagpur** (3–7 January 2023); theme **"Science and Technology for Sustainable Development with Women Empowerment"**; organised by the **Indian Science Congress Association (ISCA)**.

- **Project BHISHM:** **Bharat Health Initiative for Sahyog Hita and Maitri** – portable hospital cubes under **Project Aarogya Maitri** (announced by PM Modi at the **Voice of Global South Summit, January 2023**); each cube treats **up to 200 cases**, has **72 components**, sets up in **12 minutes**; **four cubes gifted to Ukraine** (August 2024).

- **ADITI:** **Acing Development of Innovative Technologies with iDEX** – launched by **Rajnath Singh** at **DefConnect 2024, New Delhi (4 March 2024)**; grant-in-aid **up to ₹25 crore** per start-up for critical and strategic defence technologies.
